policy.rationale: Python 3.10 reached upstream EOL on 2026-10-31. This project deliberately stays on 3.10 because that is the generation the PolyBench / PolyBench26 baselines were evaluated on, and because every pin below still ships a cp310 wheel. The pins are the LAST generation with cp310 support: upgrading past any of them either breaks the wheel or breaks comparability.

DSC6020_Project_Core.purpose: descriptors, fingerprints, classical learners, all statistics

DSC6020_Project_GNN.purpose: official polymer_chemprop graph arm, scaling and architecture runs

DSC6020_Project_Polybert.purpose: polyBERT embedding extraction only (7.3 GB weights, separate cache)
